title: False Prophets Condemned

questions.question: Against whom does chapter 13 say Ezekiel must prophesy?
options: The prophets of Israel who are prophesying
The kings of Judah and Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: The prophets of Israel who are prophesying
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:2 (ESV): "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, who are prophesying,"

questions.question: What is the characteristic of these false prophets? They prophesy from what source?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:2 (ESV): "and say to those who prophesy from their own hearts: 'Hear the word of the Lord!'"

questions.question: God says, "Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own... , and have seen...!"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:3 (ESV): "Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!"

questions.question: What animals does God compare the prophets of Israel to, "among ruins"?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:4 (ESV): "Your prophets have been like jackals among ruins, O Israel."

questions.question: What did the false prophets fail to do in the day of the Lord?
options: Go up into the breaches, or build up a wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in battle
Sound the trumpet of warning over the city
Sacrifice the required offerings in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Go up into the breaches, or build up a wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in battle
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:5 (ESV): "You have not gone up into the breaches, or built up a wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in battle in the day of the Lord."

questions.question: These prophets say, "Declares the Lord," when the Lord has not spoken. What do they expect?
options: They expect him to fulfill their word
They expect wealth from the people
They expect protection from the king
They expect the Babylonian army to fall
questions.correctAnswer: They expect him to fulfill their word
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:6 (ESV): "They have seen false visions and lying divinations. They say, 'Declares the Lord,' when the Lord has not sent them, and yet they expect him to fulfill their word."

questions.question: Because they uttered falsehood and seen lying visions, therefore God will remove them from what?
options: The council of my people, the register of the house of Israel, and the land of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The council of my people, the register of the house of Israel, and the land of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:9 (ESV): "they shall not be in the council of my people, nor be enrolled in the register of the house of Israel, nor shall they enter the land of Israel."

questions.question: What misleading message did the prophets give the people, saying, "... when there is no..."?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:10 (ESV): "Precisely because they have misled my people, saying, 'Peace,' when there is no peace,"

questions.question: When the people build a wall, what do the false prophets smear it with?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:10 (ESV): "and because, when the people build a wall, these prophets smear it with whitewash,"

questions.question: What does God say will happen to the wall smeared with whitewash when He sends His wrath?
options: A deluge of rain, great hailstones will fall, and a stormy wind break out, and it will fall
A fire will consume the wall to ash
An earthquake will swallow it whole
The Babylonians will push it over with their bare hands
questions.correctAnswer: A deluge of rain, great hailstones will fall, and a stormy wind break out, and it will fall
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:11 (ESV): "say to those who smear it with whitewash that it shall fall! There will be a deluge of rain, and you, O great hailstones, will fall, and a stormy wind break out."

questions.question: God also tells Ezekiel to set his face against the "daughters of your people." What are they doing?
options: Prophesying out of their own hearts
Baking cakes to the Queen of Heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Prophesying out of their own hearts
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:17 (ESV): "And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own hearts. Prophesy against them"

questions.question: What physical objects are these women making to sew on all wrists and on the heads of persons of every height, to hunt souls?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:18 (ESV): "Woe to the women who sew magic bands upon all wrists, and make veils for the heads of persons of every stature, in the hunt for souls!"

questions.question: For what meager payment have these women profaned the Lord among the people?
options: A few handfuls of barley and pieces of bread
Two silver coins and a new garment
A portion of meat from the altar
questions.correctAnswer: A few handfuls of barley and pieces of bread
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:19 (ESV): "You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread,"

questions.question: What effect did their lies have on the righteous and the wicked?
options: They disheartened the righteous falsely and encouraged the wicked not to turn from his evil way to save his life
They made the righteous wealthy and the wicked poor
They blinded the righteous and strengthened the wicked for battle
They confused both the righteous and the wicked equally
questions.correctAnswer: They disheartened the righteous falsely and encouraged the wicked not to turn from his evil way to save his life
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:22 (ESV): "Because you have disheartened the righteous falsely, although I have not grieved him, and you have encouraged the wicked, that he should not turn from his evil way to save his life,"

questions.question: What will God do to the false prophetesses who hunt souls like birds?
options: He will tear their magic bands from their arms and deliver His people out of their hands
He will turn them into birds to be hunted
He will strike them dumb so they can never prophesy
He will cause their veils to catch fire
questions.correctAnswer: He will tear their magic bands from their arms and deliver His people out of their hands
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 13:20-21 (ESV): "Behold, I am against your magic bands... I will tear them from your arms... Your veils also I will tear off and deliver my people out of your hand,"

key_verse_text: "Precisely because they have misled my people, saying, 'Peace,' when there is no peace, and because, when the people build a wall, these prophets smear it with whitewash,"
